description: This PHP file defines the SaveCustomFieldController class, which manages the behavior for saving custom fields in the OrangeHRM PIM module. It includes methods for initializing the service, preparing components for rendering with localization support, and integrating with the application's request handling.

classes.name: SaveCustomFieldController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the save operation of custom fields, including rendering components with localization considerations.

methods.name: getCustomFieldService
methods.description: Lazy-loads and returns an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with necessary properties for rendering, based on the request attributes.
